title: Writing Sentences
description: Learn to write complete sentences in English.

content.content:
## Writing Good Sentences

A sentence is a group of words that tells a complete thought. Every sentence needs some important parts!

content.title: What is a Sentence?
content.content:
A complete sentence needs:

**1. A subject** - WHO or WHAT the sentence is about
**2. A verb** - What the subject DOES
**3. Capital letter** at the beginning
**4. Punctuation** at the end (. ? !)

**Example:**
"**The cat** (subject) **sleeps** (verb)." ✓
"Sleeps on the sofa." ✗ (no subject)
"The big cat." ✗ (no verb)

content.title: Types of Sentences
content.content:
**Statement** - tells something (ends with .)
- "I like pizza."
- "The sun is shining."

**Question** - asks something (ends with ?)
- "Do you like pizza?"
- "What time is it?"

**Exclamation** - shows strong feelings (ends with !)
- "That's amazing!"
- "Watch out!"

content.title: Making Sentences Longer
content.content:
You can make sentences more interesting by adding:

**When:** "I play football **on Saturdays**."
**Where:** "I play football **in the park**."
**How:** "I play football **with my friends**."
**Why:** "I play football **because it's fun**."

content.title: Example: Building a Sentence
content.problem: Make a complete sentence about: dog, park, run
content.solution:
**Simple sentence:**
"The dog runs in the park."

**More detailed:**
"My brown dog runs happily in the big park."

**Both are correct! The second one has more information.**

content.content:
## Oppsummering

I dette kapittelet har du lært:

- **Complete sentences**: A sentence needs a subject (who/what) and a verb (the action).
- **Capital and end mark**: Start with a capital letter and end with . ? or !
- **Three sentence types**: Statement (.), question (?) and exclamation (!).

### Husk!
- Every sentence needs a subject AND a verb.
- Begin with a capital letter, end with . ? or !
